---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or an improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ['enhancement']
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do today, and what gets in the way? Frame the request
as a problem, not a solution.

## Proposed change

What would you want instead? Keep it concrete.

## Trade-offs

What would this change cost? Does it add a dependency, complicate the
director, or weaken the "external gates only" rule? If you have considered
alternatives, list them.
